limits: Workload uses simulated 20ms jobs, 70% creates, 20% reads, 10% cancels; target distribution may differ while no IDs exist.
Seed fixes operation choices; request completion order and selected job IDs depend on scheduling.
The assessment specifies 100 requests/second but no latency limit; the 200 ms p99 check is a project target.
manualReview: Review latency distribution and queue drain against the project target before a ship verdict.
